items.content:
RT @defendtheworld: It's BlackHat/DEF CON week so I'd like to interrupt your regularly scheduled chest drumming feed! Let's talk about a critical WiFi 7 memory corruption bug. The flaw was in Hostapd, the userland daemon which powers the world's WiFi on the majority of access points. I reported this in June and it's now patched upstream.

My proof of concept shows that authenticated clients can bypass ASLR to leak pointers OTA and inject code execution. 802.1X Enterprise WiFi 7 is basically exploitable pre-auth because of the "outer tunnel".

This bug was missed by LLM scans as well as human auditors, but found in the wifi gauntlet.

If you're at BH/DC this week and interested in the memory safe wifi stack we're building please reach out

items.content:
RT @uwu_underground: Emo time, chat.

Just wanna shout out this entire community.

If you told me years ago we'd be doing a live show with @dustrial at @defcon, I would've called absolute bullshit and asked what you were trying to sell me.

But here we are.

We love this community more than we know how to say without becoming embarrassingly sincere on main. Every time one of you messages us saying you learned about an APT, spotted a scam, discovered some cursed corner of infosec history, or decided to start learning because of something we made, it means everything.

This project can be brutally hard sometimes.

Today, the girls showed me a collection of screenshots from people who learned something, bettered themselves, found support, or poured their hearts out over our work, image, or message.

I cried like a fucking child. These tears are still running down my face while I am typing this right now.

So, genuinely, thank you.

As long as we keep this project alive, we will keep educating, supporting people, calling out scams, bullying snake oil merchants, and doing everything we can to inspire this community to learn, grow, and become better than the industry expected you to be. 

We want to work with more places in the community to achieve this in the future so very much 

We love you mammals. 
☯️
